raw_detector.name: Cramped padding
raw_detector.description: Text is too close to the edge of its container. Two shapes: (1) an element with its own text where the space between the rendered text and the border box is too small for the font size, and (2) a wrapper whose children's text lands flush against a visible boundary (border, outline, or non-transparent background) with nothing to inset it. Add at least 8px (ideally 12–16px) of space inside bordered, outlined, or colored containers.

triage.assessment: Generated font aliases, HTML entity parsing and test strings dominate this group. Live heading family is familjen and measurement family is azeretMono; layout.tsx maps these to the documented Familjen Grotesk and Azeret Mono local files. The test regex at tests/design-system.test.ts:164 is not a font declaration.
triage.live_evidence: 0.0 s and replay-time outputs compute to azeretMono with 12.8px size / 19.2px line height, not sfmono-regular.

triage.assessment: Four index.html RGB findings correspond to documented color-mix tokens: muted, line, control and soft. Remaining entries originate in generated fallback/framework/shader code or static output; they were not established as visible homepage drift.

Seven off-ramp sizes and one radius are in generated 404 pages or generated chunks. The 404 surfaces were not visually reviewed. Do not convert these into eight observed typography defects on the lab page.

Two plan-editor reports refer to the spatial editing canvas and its hidden miniature instance, both intentionally zero-padded. Live plan labels compute to 12.8/19.2px. The mobile-context padding report remains unverified because mobile rendering was explicitly out of scope.

Detector gives no element identity beyond line 0 and ratio 1.20x. Sampled current headings, measurement outputs and plan labels all compute to 1.5x. These two static findings were not reproduced in the bounded live samples; not a proof that every hidden element is clear.

labels_and_focus.tab_semantics: Scene/Robot/Route exposed as tabs with selected state and keyboard selection.
labels_and_focus.plan_handles: Named buttons expose object/route name and keyboard movement help; focused waypoint movement tested.
labels_and_focus.numeric_error: aria-invalid and associated alert verified; error text sits inside the label and becomes part of the accessible name as well as the description. Exact-name automation changed after validation. Actual screen-reader duplication was not tested.

important_claims.claim: Results come from editable inputs and nearest tested contrast is finite.
important_claims.evidence: Live waypoint keyboard change altered duration; stress grid and comparison exposed effective speed/delay and explicit non-probability/non-safety wording. evidence.ts closestContrast uses grid-index Manhattan distance, then phase and speed for ties.
important_claims.conclusion: Supported in the exercised crossing example; no robustness or optimality certification implied.

important_claims.claim: 40ms kinematics, sampled clearance, continuous collision checks and bounded duration.
important_claims.evidence: Opened methodology disclosure. model.ts defines STEP=0.04; engine.ts iterates LIMIT_SECONDS/STEP and calls hitDuring with reversal splitting. This is source inspection, not a fresh mathematical proof of the solver.
important_claims.conclusion: UI bounds the claim and distinguishes sampled clearance from collision checking.

important_claims.evidence: Visible disclosure states floorplans are references and GLB/glTF becomes axis-aligned boxes crossing a 0.08–0.6m band. import.ts shows those thresholds, mesh exclusions and self-contained resource checks.
important_claims.conclusion: Clear scope limits present. No actual import was performed.

important_claims.claim: Files stay in tab memory and fonts are local.
important_claims.evidence: Visible privacy text discloses no persistence, save-before-reload, original visual assets excluded from exports and ordinary host logs. layout.tsx registers local fonts; import.ts reads file.arrayBuffer and blocks non-data/blob model dependencies. Scoped source search found no fetch/localStorage/sessionStorage/cookie/sendBeacon/XMLHttpRequest calls in the lab and app files.
important_claims.conclusion: Consistent with inspected implementation; not a network or dependency audit.

important_claims.evidence: RouteLab.tsx save() serializes experiment, replay, run, sweep and comparison, and discloses visual reattachment.
important_claims.conclusion: Source supported; actual download round-trip not exercised.

unconfirmed_observations: The numeric validation error becomes part of the input's accessible name and its description. Potentially repetitive speech is unverified.
